title: rSwitch can be framed as a network-side Reference Monitor
content: The rSwitch orchestrable XDP pipeline can be understood as a Reference Monitor deployed on the network forwarding path: all traffic must pass through, policy cannot be bypassed, and the enforcement point is verifiable.

trigger.context: Generated while reading access control and SDP/PEP related materials

potential_value: Strengthens theoretical framing in the paper; connects Zero Trust, PDP/PEP, and the classic Reference Monitor security concept.
needs_validation: Can all three classic Reference Monitor conditions be mapped to rSwitch?
Does the XDP pipeline truly satisfy the non-bypassable requirement?
Should theoretical Reference Monitor be distinguished from engineering PEP?
